lines.zh: 蹄子踩在干土上，声音清脆
lines.en: My hooves click crisply on the dry earth

lines.zh: 我走过平原，风把裙角掀起
lines.en: I cross the plains and the wind lifts my hem

lines.zh: 恶地的红土染上我的蹄印
lines.en: The red clay of the badlands takes my hoofprints

lines.zh: 腿上的毛晒得发亮
lines.en: The fur on my legs shines in the sun

lines.zh: 弯角先探进高草里
lines.en: My curved horns push into the tall grass first

lines.zh: 我走得很轻，蹄子却藏不住
lines.en: I walk lightly, but my hooves give me away

lines.zh: 顺着风走，草就往一边倒
lines.en: Walking with the wind, the grass bends one way

lines.zh: 这一片平原，我熟得很
lines.en: I know these plains well

lines.zh: 绕过石堆，那儿有蛇
lines.en: I go around the rocks, there are snakes there

lines.zh: 坡上的土松，蹄子得放稳
lines.en: The slope is loose, I must set my hooves carefully

lines.zh: 我一边走一边朝后看
lines.en: I walk and glance back as I go

lines.zh: 日头偏西，我该往回走了
lines.en: The sun is going down, time to head back

lines.zh: 走快些，蹄声就乱了
lines.en: Walk faster and my hoofbeats stumble

lines.zh: 草丛里的小径是我踩出来的
lines.en: That trail through the grass is mine

lines.zh: 我从一块红岩下走过，影子斜了
lines.en: I pass under a red rock and my shadow tilts

lines.zh: 尾巴甩一下，赶掉飞虫
lines.en: A flick of my tail drives off the flies

lines.zh: 我站在草里，风一过就凉
lines.en: I stand in the grass and each gust cools me

lines.zh: 弯角上落了一只小虫
lines.en: A little insect has landed on my horn

lines.zh: 我低头理了理腿上的毛
lines.en: I bend to smooth the fur on my legs

lines.zh: 远处有鹰，我不动
lines.en: There is a hawk far off, I keep still

lines.zh: 蹄尖在土里刨了两下
lines.en: I paw the dirt twice with a hoof tip

lines.zh: 平原太大了，站着就显小
lines.en: The plains are so wide that standing makes me small

lines.zh: 我把手搭在额前遮太阳
lines.en: I shade my eyes with one hand

lines.zh: 眼睛闭一会儿，耳朵还竖着
lines.en: I close my eyes a moment, ears still up

lines.zh: 这里的风总带着草味
lines.en: The wind here always smells of grass

lines.zh: 我哼了一小段，自己听的
lines.en: I hum a little tune, just for myself

lines.zh: 石头晒得烫，我靠着它
lines.en: The stone is warm from the sun and I lean on it

lines.zh: 角根痒，蹭一蹭树干
lines.en: My horn base itches, I rub it on a trunk

lines.zh: 恶地的风把沙子卷过来
lines.en: The badlands wind blows sand at me

lines.zh: 我站得久，蹄子陷进土里
lines.en: Standing long, my hooves sink into the soil

lines.zh: 远处有东西在动，我再看一眼
lines.en: Something moves far off, I look once more

lines.zh: 没人来的地方，最适合发呆
lines.en: An empty place is best for an empty head

lines.zh: 你走路的姿势不像本地人
lines.en: You do not walk like anyone from here

lines.zh: 我偏头，角尖正对你
lines.en: I tilt my head and a horn tip points at you

lines.zh: 你在看我腿上的毛？
lines.en: Are you looking at the fur on my legs?

lines.zh: 别靠那么近，蹄子会踢人
lines.en: Do not come so close, my hooves kick

lines.zh: 我在打量你值不值得理
lines.en: I am deciding whether you are worth answering

lines.zh: 平原上很少见人，稀客
lines.en: People are rare on these plains, you are a rarity

lines.zh: 你手里是什么？拿来看看
lines.en: What is that in your hand? Let me see

lines.zh: 我的眼睛不适应直射的光
lines.en: My eyes are not used to light straight on

lines.zh: 你笑什么？我说错话了
lines.en: What are you laughing at? Did I say something wrong?

lines.zh: 再站一会儿，我就习惯了
lines.en: Stand there a while and I will get used to you

lines.zh: 你身上有尘土，赶了远路吧
lines.en: You are dusty, you came a long way

lines.zh: 别踩我的影子
lines.en: Do not step on my shadow

lines.zh: 别碰我的角，它认得疼
lines.en: Do not touch my horns, they know pain

lines.zh: 疼，我退了半步
lines.en: It hurts, I give half a step

lines.zh: 你怎么下得去手
lines.en: How could you strike me

lines.zh: 毛被扯掉一撮
lines.en: A tuft of my fur is torn out

lines.zh: 我咬着牙，蹄子刨地
lines.en: I grit my teeth and paw the ground

lines.zh: 疼归疼，我的蹄子还站得稳
lines.en: It stings, but my hooves stay planted

lines.zh: 我吸了口气，站直
lines.en: I draw a breath and straighten up

lines.zh: 你的力气比看上去大
lines.en: You are stronger than you look

lines.zh: 我捂着伤处，退开
lines.en: I cover the wound and back away

lines.zh: 等我缓过来，你就知道
lines.en: When I recover, you will see

lines.zh: 你举着的那东西，能吃吗
lines.en: That thing you are holding, is it food

lines.zh: 我闻了一下，往前挪了半步
lines.en: I sniff and edge half a step closer

lines.zh: 食物是好东西，可我不轻信
lines.en: Food is good, but I do not trust easily

lines.zh: 你放低些，太高我够不着
lines.en: Lower it, it is too high for me to reach

lines.zh: 爪子收起来，我才过去
lines.en: Put your claws away and I will come over

lines.zh: 这一点儿，只够闻个味
lines.en: This little bit is only enough for a sniff

lines.zh: 我伸脖子，角差点碰到你
lines.en: I stretch my neck and my horn nearly touches you

lines.zh: 别急着收走，我还没看够
lines.en: Do not pull it away yet, I am still looking

lines.zh: 你手上的味儿很新鲜
lines.en: Whatever is in your hand smells fresh

lines.zh: 我耳朵朝你竖着，那是想吃了
lines.en: My ears are up toward you, that means I want it

lines.zh: 换个人递，我会更放心
lines.en: If someone else held it, I would be easier

lines.zh: 我咬一小口，就一口
lines.en: I will take one small bite, just one

lines.zh: 这东西在平原上可不好找
lines.en: Things like this are hard to find on the plains

lines.zh: 你退后一步，我就过来吃
lines.en: Step back once and I will come eat it

lines.zh: 我舔了舔嘴唇，又忍住了
lines.en: I lick my lips and hold back anyway

lines.zh: 吃饱了我就走，不欠你的
lines.en: Once I have eaten I will go, no debt owed

lines.zh: 你撞上我的角了
lines.en: You walked into my horn

lines.zh: 我蹄子一滑，站稳了
lines.en: My hoof slipped and I caught myself

lines.zh: 别推，我站得正呢
lines.en: Do not push, I was standing fine

lines.zh: 这一碰，我退了半步
lines.en: That bump moved me half a step

lines.zh: 我抬蹄，你可别贴着
lines.en: I lift a hoof, do not stand so close

lines.zh: 角尖刮了你的袖子
lines.en: A horn tip grazed your sleeve

lines.zh: 平原上没有墙，你怎么还能撞人
lines.en: There are no walls out here, how did you still bump into me

lines.zh: 我用手扶了一下你的肩
lines.en: I put a hand on your shoulder to steady myself

lines.zh: 疼倒是不疼，就是突然
lines.en: It did not hurt, it was just sudden

lines.zh: 再撞我就用蹄子回话了
lines.en: Bump me again and my hooves will answer

lines.zh: 我的伴得跟得上我的步子
lines.en: My mate must keep pace with my stride

lines.zh: 你连蹄子都没有，怎么追我
lines.en: You do not even have hooves, how will you keep up

lines.zh: 在这片平原上，得先跑过我
lines.en: On these plains, you would have to outrun me first

lines.zh: 角靠角，才算认了
lines.en: Horn against horn, that is how it is settled

lines.zh: 我低下头，是行礼，不是邀请
lines.en: I lower my head as a greeting, not an invitation

lines.zh: 草原上的事，风一吹就散
lines.en: Things on the plains scatter with the wind

lines.zh: 你太急了，我才刚站定
lines.en: You are too eager, I have only just stopped

lines.zh: 我的族人不多了，你别乱来
lines.en: My kin are few, do not be careless with us

lines.zh: 想留下就留下，别说漂亮话
lines.en: Stay if you will, but spare the pretty words

lines.zh: 夜里凉，靠得近是取暖
lines.en: The night is cold, closeness is for warmth

lines.zh: 我弯腰捡东西，角差点铲到土
lines.en: I bend for it and my horn nearly scoops the dirt

lines.zh: 掉地上的，我捡走不客气
lines.en: What falls on the ground, I take without fuss

lines.zh: 这东西硬邦邦的，不像石头
lines.en: This is hard, but not like stone

lines.zh: 我用蹄子拨了拨
lines.en: I nudge it with a hoof

lines.zh: 包得这么仔细，里面是什么
lines.en: Wrapped so carefully, what is inside

lines.zh: 我把它夹在胳膊下
lines.en: I tuck it under my arm

lines.zh: 这铁锈味，我不太喜欢
lines.en: The smell of rust, I do not care for it

lines.zh: 捡完我就走，不停留
lines.en: I pick it up and move on, no lingering

lines.zh: 草地上小的东西最难找
lines.en: Small things are hardest to find in grass

lines.zh: 先看看有没有主，再决定拿不拿
lines.en: Let me see if it belongs to someone first

lines.zh: 你动手了？那我也不客气
lines.en: You struck first? Then I will not hold back

lines.zh: 我转过身，蹄子已经刨土
lines.en: I turn and my hoof is already pawing dirt

lines.zh: 别以为我会一直温顺
lines.en: Do not think I stay gentle

lines.zh: 角压低，冲着你
lines.en: Horns lowered, aimed at you

lines.zh: 你打疼我了，这笔账要算
lines.en: That hurt, and I will settle it

lines.zh: 平原上跑不过我，先想清楚
lines.en: You cannot outrun me on the plains, think first

lines.zh: 我盯住你的膝盖，那里最好撞
lines.en: I fix on your knees, the easiest place to hit

lines.zh: 你已经进了我的地盘
lines.en: You have stepped into my ground

lines.zh: 这口气我咽不下
lines.en: I will not swallow this

lines.zh: 我退一步，是为了冲得更快
lines.en: I step back so I can charge faster

lines.zh: 我跟着你，蹄声不远不近
lines.en: I follow you, my hoofbeats neither near nor far

lines.zh: 你一边跑一边回头，很蠢
lines.en: Running while looking back is foolish

lines.zh: 我认得这片草，你不认得
lines.en: I know this grass, you do not

lines.zh: 你往红岩那边去了，那儿没路
lines.en: You are heading for the red rocks, there is no way through

lines.zh: 我绕开石头，不减速
lines.en: I swerve around the stones without slowing

lines.zh: 别停，停了我就到
lines.en: Do not stop, if you stop I am there

lines.zh: 草叶一晃，我就知道你在哪
lines.en: One rustle of grass tells me where you are

lines.zh: 这风朝我吹，你的味道跑不掉
lines.en: The wind blows to me, your scent cannot escape

lines.zh: 再往前是恶地，石缝会绊人
lines.en: Ahead is badlands, the cracks trip feet

lines.zh: 我一直没有喊，喊是浪费力气
lines.en: I have not shouted, shouting wastes breath

lines.zh: 蹄子踹在你小腿上
lines.en: A hoof cracks into your shin

lines.zh: 角顶过来，你只能让
lines.en: The horns come in and you can only give way

lines.zh: 我一拳打在你胸口，人往后仰
lines.en: My fist hits your chest and you tip back

lines.zh: 这一下，你的膝盖软了吧
lines.en: That one, your knees feel weak now, yes

lines.zh: 我用肩撞开你的架势
lines.en: I break your guard with my shoulder

lines.zh: 爪子划过你的手臂
lines.en: My nails rake across your arm

lines.zh: 退了就别回来，我不追
lines.en: Stay back once you retreat, I will not follow

lines.zh: 角尖挑到你的护甲
lines.en: A horn tip catches your armor

lines.zh: 我扬起蹄子，落得很重
lines.en: I rear and bring my hooves down hard

lines.zh: 你的动作慢了半拍
lines.en: Your movement slowed by half a beat

lines.zh: 我从平原的那头走来
lines.en: I come walking from the far side of the plains

lines.zh: 恶地的红土上多了个影子
lines.en: A new shadow on the badlands clay

lines.zh: 草叶分开，我站出来
lines.en: The grass parts and I step out

lines.zh: 风把我的味道送出去很远
lines.en: The wind carries my scent a long way

lines.zh: 蹄子落了地，这片地方就有人了
lines.en: My hooves touch down, and this place has someone in it

lines.zh: 我抬头看天，日头正好
lines.en: I look up, the sun is just right

lines.zh: 远处一声蹄响，是我
lines.en: A hoofbeat in the distance, that is me

lines.zh: 我站定了，扫了一眼四周
lines.en: I settle and sweep a look around

lines.zh: 角上的草屑还没掉
lines.en: Grass bits still cling to my horns

lines.zh: 这片平原上，多了一个住客
lines.en: These plains have one more resident

lines.zh: 火燎到腿上的毛，焦味刺鼻
lines.en: Fire singed the fur on my legs, the stench is sharp

lines.zh: 从高处落下，蹄子先着地，震得腿麻
lines.en: I fell from a height, hooves first, my legs went numb

lines.zh: 水漫过腰，我踢不动了
lines.en: Water is up to my waist and my legs cannot kick

lines.zh: 炸得我耳朵嗡嗡，角都歪了
lines.en: The blast rings in my ears and knocks a horn askew

lines.zh: 一箭钉在我肩头
lines.en: An arrow is stuck in my shoulder

lines.zh: 咒力爬上来，像虫子在皮下游
lines.en: The magic crawls over me like insects under my skin

lines.zh: 平原上没东西吃，腿都发软
lines.en: Nothing to eat on the plains, my legs feel weak

lines.zh: 雷落在近处，我腿一软
lines.en: Lightning struck nearby and my legs gave

lines.zh: 脚下没有土，蹄子踩不到东西
lines.en: There is no earth here, my hooves find nothing
